title: 425 - Alpha Therapeutics, Inc.
filingText:
Filed by Alpha Therapeutics, Inc.
Subject Company: Beta Bio, Inc.

Press Release
Alpha Therapeutics, Inc. announced that it entered into a definitive merger agreement by and among Alpha Therapeutics, Inc., Beta Bio, Inc. and Alpine Merger Sub, Inc. Under the terms of the merger agreement, each Beta Bio share will be converted into the right to receive $12.50 in cash and 0.60 shares of Alpha common stock. The companies said the transaction value is approximately $4.2 billion and represents a 37% premium to Beta Bio's unaffected closing price. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
